nodes.label: Patreon OAuth Authentication Flow
nodes.rationale: Routes authentication through backend OAuth endpoint to exchange authorization code for JWT tokens stored in localStorage.

nodes.label: Smallest Complete Change Principle
nodes.rationale: Solve problems with the least new code by favoring existing abstractions, platform APIs, and deletions over new wrappers and boilerplate.

nodes.label: Declarative SWR Conditional Fetching
nodes.rationale: Declarative useSWR with null key conditional fetching provides automatic caching, deduplication, and error handling with less code than imperative useEffect hooks.

nodes.label: Fetch Timeout and Cache Revalidation
nodes.rationale: Using AbortSignal.timeout(10000) and 60-second Next.js revalidation prevents fetch requests from hanging indefinitely and reduces backend server load.

nodes.label: Patreon Tier and Ad Suppression Monetization Model
nodes.norm_label: patreon tier and ad suppression monetization model
nodes.rationale: Active Patreon members get an ad-free premium experience and direct PRO downloads, while non-patron and unauthenticated users see AdSense units and membership unlock prompts.
